answer_2.quote: We leverage three metrics in the evaluation, including mean reciprocal rank (MRR), average normalized rank (ANR), and attack success rate (ASR@k).

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to evaluate the stealthiness of backdoor attacks... We recruit six computer science undergraduates... Participants had no prior backdoor knowledge, but were provided with necessary information... we ask them to label whether a given code snippet is clean or poisoned.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to label each code snippet as either clean or poisoned (containing a backdoor trigger).
